CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, August 19, 2026 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Justin Love, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE JULY 15, 2026 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until approved by the  August 19, 2026
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, July 15, 2026
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:05 P.M. on Wednesday July 15, 2026 in Conference Room “A” at Alhambra City Hall, 111
South First Street Alhambra, 91801.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, and Commission Member Navarro.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Love.
Staff Present: Deputy Director Houghton and Clerical Assistant II Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE JUNE 17, 2026 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Commission Member Hermano and a second from Vice President Saunders,
the June 17, 2026 minutes were approved as written.

“PRIDE OF ALHAMBRA” UTILITY BOX ART PROPOSAL
Deputy Director Houghton informed that the proposal will not take place as the artist is now
working with the Alhambra Chamber of Commerce on a utility box art campaign.

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission addressed public art strengths and
obstacles at the Alhambra Community Center while examining renderings from their research;
recycled stained-glass kinetic sculptures from Commissioner Hermano, peace poles and
sculptures from Vice President Saunders, and sculptures from President Canseco.

STAFF REPORT
The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission approved a sketch from Fernando
Reyes that will be displayed during his November 2026 art exhibition in the Alhambra City Hall
Lobby Art Gallery.

As recommended by Vice President Saunders, “Where Life is Worthwhile” was selected as
Alhambra’s 2027 Tournament of Roses Parade Float title.

Deputy Director Houghton shared that this year’s Fourth of July Celebration was spectacular and
invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission and their families to attend the
upcoming Concerts and Movies in the Park on Friday and Saturday evenings at the Alhambra
Park Bandshell in July.
 PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Commission Member Navarro is interacting with six potential artists for the Alhambra City Hall
Lobby Art Gallery and Clerical Assistant II Rivadeneyra will send the Art Exhibition Proposal
and calendar to the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission as reference.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Navarro, the
July 15, 2026 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:48 P.M.
